body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2007') -- <Visual News> Samsung Electronics announces its news ‘T9 (YP-T9)’ and ‘K3’ MP3 players in CES 2007.
These slim, portable MP3 players pack a complete portfolio of multimedia features and applications into a sleek, compact device.
The T9 MP3 players are available in jet black and deep purple, come in 2GB and 4GB versions using Samsung’s high-quality NAND flash memory.
The T9 player is available now for MSRPs of $129.99 (2GB), and $179.99 (4GB), respectively (U.S. Market).
